Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing the purchase of anaerobic digestion power.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to anaerobic digestion power; and adding a newsection to chapter 19.29A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.29A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, a stateagency that is served by a public or private utility must purchase allavailable anaerobic digestion power from the local electric utilitywhen the producer of the power sends a written purchase request to theagency. Purchases by a state agency shall not exceed the agency'sannual electricity consumption. A state agency shall pay for anaerobicdigestion power at no less than the retail price that the localelectric utility charges that customer. (2) State agencies are not required to purchase all availableanaerobic digestion power from their local electric utility if theutility is exempt from offering a qualified alternative energy resourceas defined in RCW 19.29A.090. (3) To the extent that a local electric utility purchases powerfrom an anaerobic digestion power producer in its service territory, p. 1 HB 1035the utility must pay the producer an amount no less than the retailprice that the utility charges a state agency in this section, minusadministrative costs that do not exceed five percent of that amount. (4) For the purposes of this section, "anaerobic digestion power"means the electricity generated from an instate facility thatprocesses manure or other organic substrates into biogas usingmicroorganisms in a decomposition process within a closed, oxygenfreecontainer.
